# Labels

The issue labels Vulngraph uses and what each one means. The bug and feature
forms apply `bug` and `enhancement`; maintainers apply the others.

| Label | Meaning |
| ----- | ------- |
| `bug` | Something is broken; applied by the bug form |
| `enhancement` | A feature request; applied by the feature form |
| `good first issue` | Small, well-scoped, mentor-friendly; linked from `CONTRIBUTING.md` |
| `help wanted` | Maintainers would welcome an outside contribution |
| `needs-spec` | Requires a spec (`docs/specs/`) before implementation |
| `needs-triage` | New, not yet reviewed by a maintainer |
| `area/api` | HTTP API / OpenAPI contract |
| `area/frontend` | React UI |
| `area/connectors` | Cloud / IAM / CI connectors |
| `area/graph-engine` | Ladybug / graph engine (`internal/graphdb/`) |
| `area/storage` | Postgres / ClickHouse / migrations |
| `area/deploy` | Helm chart, Dockerfile, docker compose |
| `area/ci` | GitHub Actions, release pipeline |
| `area/docs` | Documentation |
